eyebrow: Work directly with a professional software engineer
title: No account managers. No bloated packages. Just good work.
description: I’m a professional software engineer who works directly with small businesses. You get honest recommendations, direct communication, and a website built with care—nothing more complicated than your business needs.

research.description: In BrightLocal’s survey of more than 1,000 consumers, 36% named a business’s own website as a trusted source for researching local businesses—placing it among the top three.
